rows.notes: The study is explicitly a literature review (title 'Review'; Section 1 describes an exploratory, non-systematic literature search) with no own data, experiment, survey or model runs. It describes the WA+ framework (Section 3.1) only by citing IWMI/IHE-Delft and refs [55-57], and the statement about a common information base acceptable to all stakeholders (Sections 3.3, 6) is a conceptual recommendation drawn from FAO reports [21,22], not an own result on remote sensing improving inter-agency coordination.
